comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus flatten and secure a curled drawing on a plan table.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool engagement, controlled adjustment, counterholding, and physical cycling versus bimanual deformable-sheet unrolling and coordinated weight placement.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe repeatable stops and collar retention versus plan centered on the outline, flat, weighted at both ends, and released. No centering or flatness tolerance is stated.
comparison.reason: Deformable sheet management and rigid damper commissioning require meaningfully different tested abilities.
